== Original post ==

'''A bunch of Simple Tricks and Nonsense'''
* '''Author:''' shane "elvis solo" engelking
* '''Published:''' March 7, 2004
* '''Rating:''' 4.87
* '''Description:''' Luke-may the force be with you- You too. This is the deck that I got 2nd at MN states with (and went 2-2. 4+22 at worlds day 2, losing to Chu by 15 and Pistone by 2.)it is in semi retirement, as I am playing other things, but i think it is still a g

=== Strategy ===

ALL RIGHT_FIRST OFF I FORGOT TO LIST KESSEL!!!!!!!!!!!!!

Well this was meant to be posted as an advanced deck, but as usual i forgot that beginner was the default setting. Rather than reposting it, I'll leave as is, because it is legible and the darn thing took so long to type up. don't be a moron and let that affect youur judgements.  I think I will puke the next time i hear someone say " -1 star for putting it as a beginner deck"

and it is one card over, but that is just because i always take one out befor i play a tournament based upon my guess of what i expect.

So, the strat is this-Set up quick at kessel with Han. falcon Artoo first turn usuall, then luke to the cantina second Meese/C/TV makes this easy to set up), shut down force loss, using fades, honor, we're doomed and the various bullet cards, and whatever you do lose retrieve....  never think the game is over becacause of we're doomed, and if they don't grab something else, chances are you've exploited them with something else so much that this card doesn't even come into play)then kessel run.  The only real damage you will do to your opponent is 3 a turn at kessel and the cantina with Luke, and possibly a bit of Direct damage with Legendary and Leebo.  I will be the first to admit this deck is extremely difficult to play well, because of the endless possibilities and the responsive style of this deck.  The key IS SHUTTING DOWN FORCE LOSS in various ways, like menace fades, honor, and We're doomed, while training yourself to understand how to get any card you want in this deck in one or two turns with C/TV HDWGITM.  Like for instance, if you can't get a t-47 battle formation in your hand in the first three turns ALMOST EVERY TIME, then this is not the deck for you.  If you CAN, this is the type of deck that in your hands will be endless frustration for your opponent.  Not to mention it will confuse the heck out of your opponent, who will see a sure victory turn into a 35 card loss.  This deck just REFUSES TO DIE.  I have retrieved as much as 40 force in one game, and in that game retrieved 11 3 straight turns. Once, after getting my opponent to pull all his shields (which is definitely something to consciously get your opponent to do), i retrieved 22 force in one keesel run, start to finish in one turn.  You deploy Kessel run targeting Melas, fly him in the some ship with R2-d2 straight from corellia to kessel, ship dock him onto the Pulsar Skate along with artoo, add his ability to X, double X with R Ryjerd V. That's 2(7+4)=22. Then fly him back IN THE SAME TURN!

We're doomed-when you get down in life force, or (chuckle) draw up a monster hand to only have 14 life force (WHICH YOU CAN PUT BACK TO DRAW ONE CARD WITH HDWGITM AT THE END OF THE GAME), you play this after they grabbed one of your zillion interrupts that you have already played.  Then cut all damage in half rounding down for r2.  For example.  Dark Deal.  They have deal out AND occupation.  You have menace fades satisfied as well as we're doomed, and have cancelled occupation.  They drain once for 1. (as they get 1st action of their control phase), then all their drains of 3 are reduced to 1 with fades, cut in half to .5, then rounded down to........ ZERO!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!  There are plenty of little things like this hidden amongst this deck, and i am sure you can invent them with each new game and matchup you find, because all the defensive tools to combat ANYTHING are found in this deck.

Vs deal- Set Up Fades.kessel run... Look for lando w/gun.  Attack with ships only when neccesary.  cancel occupation.  If he grabs Free ride combo, then you play we're doomed the rest of the game..  If he doesn't, cancel occupation again.  Shouldn't even get to the point of were doomed then.

LSC-Set up in space and then flip, then drop luke to the core..  don't battle....  Use mess of TV or whatever to find Luke's back V....  Try not to look too happy when you win every combat, then SATM his jedi.

VS. Senate....  Drop a puny ship.... Let him shoot his gun...  Let him get rid of the 7 on his fish.  then set up kessel runs with his no hyperspeed ships sitting somewhere else with han and artoo/DLS, and set up luke over and over on the ground.... Satm/Bpro is your friend:)  so is fallen portal.  this game is one you have to really feel out...  Cancel the drain canceller, then drain so he cant first strike, then cancel the destiny adder, so he will have trouble cracking the 7 immunity that luke and your ships have. n Very winnable, but you have to be on your toes.

VS.Walkers

I love this matchup....  Ignore him-hje won't be used to that.  Get out honor.... Get T-47 (this is where the gearing of the deck to get any card in hand quick helps)Grab W.Garrison (cause he most likely wont have the other in hand) get him to grab something dumb.  then play were doomed as you kessel run all day...

Win by a lot.

CCT use chewie on the falcon, then go about your business.  han and lando missing are not that bif of a deal.

vs huntdown- if it is dueling, try to hide the smile on your face as you stare at luke's back V..  Set up in space, flip, thn drop luke in front of Vader...  (Pull affect min first)  cancel all but the one combat card draw, then subtract 3.  win by an obscene amount, then vader is OOP, and you will win by a lot....

The womprat tech Huntdown is the hardest matchup for this deck....  If you know haw to beat it with this deck LMK....

As far as traditional Huntdown, let him come to the ground first, set up luke elsewhere, and then dominate in space.  Hope you like it.....
